raw_segments.text: In a little time, she said, you'll know where to swim to, but just now we'll follow
Sea Pig the porpoise, for he is very wise.
A school of porpoises were ducking and tearing through the water, and little Kotick followed
them as fast as he could.
How do you know where to go to? he panted.
The leader of the school rolled his white eye and ducked under.
My tail tingles, youngster, he said.
That means there's a gale behind me.
When you're south of the sticky water he meant the equator, and your tail tingles.
That means there's a gale in front of you and you must head north.
